title: Ability/world implementation records and story-life checkpoint: concrete consumers and unrun gates
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: complete historical implementation/design/coverage record with explicit behavior limits
reviews.disposition:
Complete review of the14-line four-family coverage map and40-line skill return preserves the exact consumer scope: brace control uses consenting nonlethal responses and actual vitality; trail reading learns a procedure consumed by the existing survey/board owner; timber judgment spends owned logs at the shared bench for actual kits; shared inquiry reserves/funds the teacher and records actual current reports. Family discovery, learned method, mastery, native XP/unlock, source support and executable use remain distinct. Recovery controls are real local consumers, not an invented universal cure. Native readiness/build confirmation and19-command registry validation were explicitly integrated-built-unverified at the recorded source/bundle, with changed behavior/save/failure/discovery/UI gates deferred. No source registry, bundle, publication packet or gameplay was freshly checked here.

The chosen four-mastery endpoint, paid teacher/Lio/focus requirements, dry bench, usable hands and local base.frontier binding are reversible original definitions for this wave, not global rules for learning, bodies, fees or cross-world powers. Frozen job completion and live response support have different policies. Retaining a method does not conjure its foreign teacher/tool; a genuinely self-sufficient faculty can retain stronger means according to its actual law. The old four-family exception/world hold and implementation-first deferral are historical authorization boundaries, not today's queue or general testing exemption. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [lead-life rules](../../../LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md), AD36/AD43 and optional human review govern selected work. Preserve all named unrun acquisition, cancellation, custody, site/weather, native publication, repeat/reload and leak gates without claiming current failure or rerunning them for a documentation review.
reviews.evidence: Complete14/40/15/17/13-line inputs read; skill-return first two title/blank lines recovered after tail read. Existing15-line story checkpoint also fully reread for later disposition without extra review credit. No linked JSON/source/private/play evidence reopened.
reviews.reopen: Use current selected consumer, current ownership and exact changed-input evidence. Preserve implemented-unverified and finite original definitions without old global milestone.

reviews.disposition:
All17 original README lines were reviewed. Revision21 remainder c12c1524b341, revision13 Frontier f381c6503a58 and the four-skill246dd626feeb delivery are separate source/native-binding/UI/build receipts, explicitly implemented-unverified at their recorded inputs. Counts of282 maps,19 remainder rows,33 parents/15 steps/seven endings and registry definitions do not prove played campaigns or source-world completion. Keep original static/model/build checks separate from deferred behavior, persistence, failure, keyboard and regression gates; later actual evidence may close only its matched scope. Do not inherit an old implementation-first waiver for new code.

Later [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md), [lead-life](../../LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) and current world rules supersede the retired one-realm/prestige gate, old Frontier/Glasshouse build order and launch/pause/owner statements. Historical releases describe those finite deliveries, not current running workers or new writer/integration/commit/push authority. Actual functions, ending consequences, source qualification, adversary mechanisms and sealed information remain useful requirements when selected. Current AD36/AD43 and AD42 optional review apply. This documentation pass did not inspect the linked JSON/source/bundles, change a runtime, open private content or exercise gameplay.

reviews.classification: complete historical implementation/design/coverage record with explicit behavior limits
reviews.disposition:
The complete13-line pre-delivery checkpoint was read against this complete15-line revision3 checkpoint. The earlier instruction to rebuild and exercise the story loop was followed by only the specifically recorded partial browser observations and source/model/build delivery; the unavailable browser connection left watch/account/conversation, timed reload/import, keyboard and performance unverified at that date. The optional watching implementation avoided a new site requirement that would strand already-enrolled saves. Additive command/knowledge compatibility is a stated contract, not a newly verified save journey here. Premature source-release disclosure, the pre-hero dynamic item-name failure and the accidental shared-build repair retain their separate causes and records.

Historical preview ports, processes, child releases and peer reservations are not live handles or permission to restart them. The latest documentation-only task does not resume source integration or browser checks. Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md), [UI rules](../../UI_RULES.md) and AD36/AD43 govern any selected current consumer; AD42 makes human review optional. The old realm/prestige wording is retired. Preserve known story/cost/clock/observer boundaries and all open technical proof without declaring the later current game broken. No linked evidence file, generated save, source, browser or private library was reopened.
